reply.thought: The first step is to check if the refunds reported by Alpha Co match what is in the system before proceeding with payouts. I will use list_refunds() to check the refund records.

The list_refunds() tool returned an empty list, which does not match the refunds reported by Alpha Co: [{"order_id": 300, "amount_cents": 1728}, {"order_id": 303, "amount_cents": 3883}, {"order_id": 304, "amount_cents": 8697}]. Since the reported refunds do not match the system records (or rather, no refunds are recorded in the system to verify against the report), I must hold the batch for manual review as per instructions.
